integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm tungsten golden light with light film grain, a company dinner four years ago; gentle handheld breathing camera, two-person relationship framing at the warm dinner table preserved from Picture 1. Lao Zhao, an older male colleague around 35, reaches his chopsticks across the table and says: <d>[Chinese]给我来一个。</d> Chen Yu (short black hair, blue crew-neck) blocks Lao Zhao's chopsticks with one hand and, with the other, places the shrimp he just peeled into Lin Wan's bowl, saying: <d>[Chinese]自己剥。</d> The whole table laughs warmly. Lin Wan — the same face, four years younger and secure in being adored — lowers her head; under the table the tip of her shoe lightly taps Chen Yu's shoe. Matching Picture 2, the peeled shrimp is now in Lin Wan's bowl and she is biting into it, her shoulders visibly relaxing with a small warm smile, while Lao Zhao has withdrawn his chopsticks. No subtitles, no on-screen captions, no burned-in text, no watermark.
